summary: AGNT, Inc. filed an 8-K covering indemnification agreements with directors/officers, a name change amendment from eXp World Holdings to AGNT, Inc., and a previously approved redomestication to Delaware. These are routine governance actions: entry into standard indemnification contracts and a name change approved by the board without stockholder vote. The redomestication was already disclosed. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event is present. The filing does not trigger a special-situations category; it is a routine current report.
